name: 3data / Alias Group Krasnodar commercial data center
notes: First Krasnodar Territory commercial data center announced under 3data franchise model; first phase planned for 200 racks at 7 kW IT load per rack, launch targeted for end-2023. Later operational status not confirmed in searched public sources.

name: SGK-supported commercial mining data center in Kemerovo
developer: Private mining data center operator; Siberian Generating Company provided premises and grid infrastructure
notes: Interfax reported SGK provided idle production space and electric-grid infrastructure for a commercial data processing center used as a mining farm, located in Kemerovo at a decommissioned boiler-house site.

name: Rostelecom Kaliningrad Data Center
developer: Rostelecom PJSC; built by NVision Group
notes: DatacenterMap lists a Rostelecom facility at Prospekt Leninskiy 32, inaugurated 2012, 150 sq m, 20 server cabinets, 100 kW useful power.

name: MegaFon Khabarovsk data center
notes: MegaFon announced a new Khabarovsk Krai data center; regional coverage reports modular deployment with phased expansion up to 1 MW and 110 racks.

name: Nyagan SEZ data center
developer: Khanty-Mansi Autonomous Okrug-Yugra / Nyagan SEZ; investor not publicly confirmed
notes: Investment portal describes a planned data center in the Nyagan special economic zone for colocation and traffic exchange. Later regional reporting in 2026 indicated an earlier investor agreement had not yet produced the facility, so status remains planned.

name: RusHydro corporate data center at Sayano-Shushenskaya HPP
developer: RusHydro; Government of the Republic of Khakassia
notes: RusHydro and the Khakassia government signed an agreement at SPIEF 2026 to build a corporate data center on the Sayano-Shushenskaya HPP site; planned implementation period reported as two years.
